盘古虚影盘坐在沧源对面，目光中带着一丝考量的意味："你有何打算？"
沧源沉默了片刻，目光投向虚无深处，仿佛能穿透盘古的遮蔽帷幕看到那片正在被黑潮侵蚀的无垠之地。
"把我带入他的视角想一下。"沧源缓缓开口："他大张旗鼓地入侵混沌时代，倾巢而出，亲自坐镇，耗费了五亿年去搜索我们的踪迹。"
"他所面临的问题，以及迫切想要找到我的原因，不难看出。"
沧源伸出一根手指："第一，那半颗道果定在他手中，但他拿那颗道果没办法，他需要用我来当突破口，掌握那半颗道果。"
他伸出第二根手指："他这么急，说明他被那颗道果逼得没辙了。"
盘古闻言，赞同地点点头："那苍帝有两把刷子，但不入大罗天，终为蝼蚁。
不入大罗天，任凭你是何等的惊才绝艳、才情无双，也休想撼动大罗天的手段，更何况是大罗天的道果了。"
沧源继续道："他这番大张旗鼓的入侵而来，所谓之事已经呼之欲出了，他觊觎我，他需要我作为桥梁去炼化那颗道果。"
"而我不管如何，都是要拿回我的道果的。"
他顿了顿，眼中闪过一丝明亮的光泽："既然如此……倒不如将计就计。"
盘古沉默了片刻，随即发出一阵粗犷的大笑："哈哈哈哈，善！"
盘古大神说话向来粗犷豪迈，动不动就是"孙贼""吾一斧子劈了你"，什么时候用过"善"这种文绉绉的字眼？
但盘古那张粗犷的脸上看不出任何异常，依旧是一副大大咧咧的表情。
自己身旁的这位盘古……也不简单呐。
黑潮已经将大片虚无侵蚀成了一片扭曲的黑暗领域。
目之所及全是翻涌的污染之力与永不停歇的诡异低语。
苍帝盘坐于黑潮之巅，周身环绕着无数细如游丝的感应线条，那些线条如同无数根触手般延伸向四面八方，不断地试探、搜索、渗透。

那些感应线条中，有一道极其细微的、几乎无法察觉的波动从某处虚空中反馈了回来。
苍帝猛地睁开眼，漆黑的瞳孔中爆发出两道刺目的光芒。
祂低喝一声，抬手一指，指尖凝聚出一道贯穿维度的黑色光柱，精准地刺入那道波动传来的方向。
盘古的遮蔽帷幕在那一刻终于裂开了一道微不可察的缝隙。
苍帝的瞳孔中映出了一座模糊的、被层层法则包裹的人造大界的轮廓。
祂的声音中带着五亿年积压下来的疯狂与兴奋，回荡在整片被黑潮侵蚀的虚无之中。
也看到了……躲在天道空间中的沧源！
“但不入大罗天，纵然你盘古是神话中的创世神又如何，本帝……照样能破了你的手段！”
“眼下，首要目的，就是该怎样在盘古的眼皮子底下，把他给带走了。”
甚至除了盘古，仅有那个叫始帝的修为在道尊十二重天。

> Chapter 671: Taking advantage of the situation (Page 1)
Pangu's shadow sat cross-legged opposite Cangyuan, with a hint of consideration in his eyes: "What are your plans?"
Cangyuan was silent for a moment, looking into the depths of nothingness, as if he could see through Pangu's covering curtain and see the boundless land that was being eroded by the black tide.
"Take me into his perspective for a moment." Cangyuan said slowly: "He invaded the Age of Chaos with great fanfare, came out in full force, and personally took charge, spending 500 million years searching for our traces."
"It's not hard to see the problems he faced and why he was so desperate to find me."
Cangyuan stretched out a finger: "First, the half of the Dao Fruit is definitely in his hand, but he can't do anything about it. He needs to use me as a breakthrough point to control the half of the Dao Fruit."
He stretched out his second finger: "The fact that he is so anxious means that he is cornered by that Dao Fruit."
Pangu heard the words and nodded in agreement: "That Cang Emperor has two brushes, but if he doesn't enter the Great Luotian, he will end up as an ant.
If you don't enter Da Luotian, no matter how amazing and talented you are, you can't even think of shaking Da Luotian's methods, let alone Da Luotian's Dao Fruit. "
Cangyuan continued: "His invasion came with great fanfare, and the so-called incident has already been revealed. He covets me, and he needs me as a bridge to refine the Dao Fruit."
"And no matter what, I will get my Tao Fruit back."
He paused, and a bright light flashed in his eyes: "In this case... it's better to use the trick."
Pangu was silent for a moment, and then burst into a rough laugh: "Hahahaha, good!"
The Great God Pangu always spoke in a rough and bold manner, always using the words "Sun thief" or "I will chop you with an axe". When did he ever use the word "good" in such a formal way?
But there was nothing unusual about Pangu's rough face, and he still had a carefree expression.
The Pangu next to him... was not simple either.
The black tide has eroded the vast void into a twisted realm of darkness.
Everything as far as the eye can see is the surging power of pollution and the weird whispers that never stop.
Cang Emperor sat cross-legged on the top of the black tide, surrounded by countless induction lines as thin as gossamers. Those lines extended in all directions like countless tentacles, constantly probing, searching, and penetrating.
Among those sensing lines, an extremely subtle, almost imperceptible wave was fed back from somewhere in the void.
Emperor Cang opened his eyes suddenly, and two dazzling lights burst out from his dark pupils.
He shouted low, raised his hand and pointed, and his fingertips condensed a black light beam that penetrated the dimension, accurately piercing the direction of the wave.
Pangu's covering curtain finally cracked an imperceptible gap at that moment.
The Cang Emperor's pupils reflected the outline of a vague man-made world wrapped in layers of laws.
His voice contained the madness and excitement accumulated over 500 million years, echoing throughout the void eroded by the black tide.
I also saw... Cangyuan hiding in the Tiandao space!
"But if you don't enter Daluotian, even if you, Pangu, are the mythical creation god, this emperor... can still defeat your methods!"
"Right now, the primary goal is how to take Pangu away under his nose."
Even apart from Pangu, only the one named Shidi was in the twelfth level of Dao Zun.
